title: Grid
summary: Equal-width responsive columns: as many columns of at least min as fit, one column on a phone.

props.name: min
props.description: Minimum column width as a CSS length (for example 12rem or 200px). Columns are equal width and never narrower than this, so the grid drops to one column when the container is narrower than two.

props.name: columns
props.description: The most columns to use, 0 for no limit. The grid still drops columns when they would be narrower than min.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Unequal columns as a ratio, for example 2:1 (a wide main column and a narrow side) or 1:2:1. Empty keeps equal auto-fit columns. Overrides min and columns; on a phone (640px and below) the grid falls back to auto columns so it stacks.

props.name: tracks
props.description: An explicit column track list as CSS writes it, for a fixed grid such as a 12-column dashboard (repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr))) or uneven columns (minmax(0, 1.5fr) minmax(0, 1fr), 12rem 1fr). Use minmax(0, ...) so wide content does not blow a track out. Children then take columns with data-col-span (see the default slot). Overrides ratio, min and columns; a value the browser cannot parse is ignored with one warning. On a phone (640px and below) the grid falls back to auto columns so it stacks and data-col-span and data-row-span stop applying. For plain proportions, ratio (1.5:1) is shorter.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between children, on the spacing scale (none 0, xs --space-1, sm --space-2, md --space-4, lg --space-6, xl --space-8). Default md (the card gap).

slots.description: The items to lay out. Any child can carry data-col-span="2" to "12" (spans that many columns) and data-row-span="2" to "4" (spans that many rows), meant for a grid with tracks; on a pk-* child it is a plain attribute (<PkCard data-col-span="6"> in Blazor). Not applied on a phone.

cssProperties.name: --pk-grid-min
cssProperties.description: The column minimum; set by the min prop.

cssProperties.name: --pk-grid-columns
cssProperties.description: The column cap; set by the columns prop.

cssProperties.name: --pk-grid-ratio
cssProperties.description: The explicit column list; set by the ratio prop.

a11y: A plain layout box with no role; the DOM order is the reading order, so a single column on a phone keeps the same order.

examples.title: A 12-column dashboard
examples.html: <pk-grid tracks="repeat(12, minmax(0, 1fr))"><pk-card heading="Revenue" data-col-span="8">Wide</pk-card><pk-card heading="Users" data-col-span="4">Narrow</pk-card><pk-card heading="Orders" data-col-span="4">A</pk-card><pk-card heading="Refunds" data-col-span="4">B</pk-card><pk-card heading="Churn" data-col-span="4">C</pk-card><pk-card heading="Activity" data-col-span="12">Full width</pk-card></pk-grid>

examples.title: Uneven tracks
examples.html: <pk-grid tracks="minmax(0, 1.5fr) minmax(0, 1fr)"><pk-card heading="Main">1.5 parts</pk-card><pk-card heading="Side">1 part</pk-card></pk-grid>

examples.title: At most three columns
examples.html: <pk-grid columns="3" min="8rem" gap="lg"><pk-card heading="A">1</pk-card><pk-card heading="B">2</pk-card><pk-card heading="C">3</pk-card><pk-card heading="D">4</pk-card></pk-grid>
